start: Member on a screen that crashes

steps.action: Use a screen until it crashes

must_not: The app slowed down or stuck while the report is sent

start: An error nothing caught closes the app

user_sees: The app closes within about 1.5 seconds
must_not: The app hanging open waiting for the report

start: Member offline when a screen crashes, or a development build

must_not: A second error because the report could not be sent
A report from a development build

start: The same screen crashes three times, then six different crashes in one run

steps.action: Crash the same screen three times
must_not: Three reports of the same crash
More than 5 reports in one run

start: A crash happens while member data is on screen

must_not: The member's name, gym code, install id, phone model or workouts in the report
A database error's details in the report

start: The app's global error handler gets an error in a release build

must_not: The second address also posted after the first saved it

start: A screen's error boundary logs '[ScreenErrorBoundary] a screen crashed:'

steps.action: Read the log line and send it as a 'screen' report
user_sees: One report with the component stack added
must_not: The log line itself changed or lost

start: The first address answers 404 or 500, or both addresses give no answer in 8 s

user_sees: The report saved at the old address, or a warning in the log
must_not: A thrown error inside the crash handler

start: The same error message comes twice in one run

must_not: A second report of the same kind
